epbs_builder_api.highlight: Three open PRs: Key Manager API, Beacon API produce-block endpoint, builder spec (PR #165)
Per-builder P2P bid boosting/min-bid is technically broken — P2P propagates on raw value, not boosted factor
Consensus to remove per-builder P2P boost/min-bid config; global P2P boost factor retained

epbs_gossip_validation.highlight: Potuz: bid validation against non-head state should remain IGNORE, not REJECT — changing to REJECT would cause Prysm to drop all non-head bids, killing multi-bid functionality
Consensus to keep balance-check as IGNORE; Lodestar will still use correct state locally

epbs_epoch_boundary.highlight: Lodestar seeing double epoch transitions from bids built on parent at epoch boundary; Nico added a guard in Lodestar (PR #9756)
Potuz's spec PR removes epoch-boundary shuffling-stability check — Lighthouse and Prysm already behave this way on mainnet

sparse_blob_pool_engine_api.highlight: Bosul: sparse blob pool Engine API discussed at last ACD; Lighthouse raised design concerns but no counter-proposal submitted; other clients already implemented; proceed unless significant objections raised async

action_items.action: Remove per-builder P2P boost/min-bid config from Key Manager API and Beacon API PRs
Add rationale paragraph to epoch-boundary shuffling-stability spec PR
Review sparse blob pool Engine API proposal async; share objections if any

decisions.decision: Per-builder P2P bid boosting and min-bid config removed from ePBS specs
Builder bid balance-check kept as IGNORE (not REJECT) on gossip path
ePBS API PRs to be implemented by clients before merging; merge after successful devnet validation
